examples.rationale: Rivers avg 352.7 passYds/gm. OAK defense is weak (PA 124). Home game, calm wind (4mph), warm (77F). Keenan Allen (100 recYds avg) and Antonio Gates returning boost targets. Strong volume expectation.
Brady avg 339.8 yds/gm, NE 5-0 high-scoring offense, hosting NYJ at home. NYJ allows points (75 PA) but Brady's floor is well above 250. Home chalk but volume overwhelmingly supports over.
Brady avg 2.8 TDs/gm through 5 games. NE 5-0, likely in positive game script vs NYJ. Home, warm enough, clear pace advantage for NE offense.
Hopkins avg 121 recYds/gm, elite target share (14.8 tgts/gm). Cecil Shorts out increases targets. HOU vs MIA outdoors, 13mph wind but Hopkins volume is massive enough to overcome.
Fitzgerald avg 97.2 recYds/gm with 9 targets/gm. ARI 4-2 vs BAL 1-5 in a dome. Palmer averaging 2.33 TDs. Favorable matchup vs weak BAL secondary, indoor environment.
Bell avg 97.5 rushYds/gm in 4 games. KC defense has allowed heavy scoring (PA 159). Ben Roethlisberger questionable so PIT may lean run game more. Outdoor, mild conditions.
Thomas avg 49 recYds with 7.5 tgts in only 2 games. BUF missing Tyrod Taylor (Out), new starter expected to struggle; JAX at home vs porous BUF defense (PA 139). Positive game script likely.
Jones avg 106.3 recYds/gm with 12 tgts/gm. ATL 5-1 vs TEN 1-4 with Mariota Out. Outdoor mild conditions, favorable matchup, ATL likely in positive game script as road favorites.
